exercises.why: **собираюсь** — собира́ться (imperfective): (intransitive) to gather, to assemble; to be going (somewhere), to be heading (off) (somewhere); to be about to (do something), to be going to (do something), to intend (to do something), to mean (to do something). Wiktionary: собира́ть + -ся.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to gather, to assemble mutually reflexive
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: брать — to take; собира́ться — (intransitive) to gather, to assemble; собра́ние — meeting, gathering; собра́ться — to gather, to assemble mutually reflexive.
**выбрал** — вы́брать (perfective): to choose, to select, to pick out; to elect; to take everything out; to haul in (net), to pull up (anchor). Wiktionary: вы- + брать.
